content: Babilɔn ban'pay
Ungö apan, mɛ kàmɛn un'kyeey asin kan'fà du: nde kàkäl anà ikɔ̈b mwɛy kyà kölàköl anà làkoo ande làpɛ kyɛɛy u mɛɛn.

Nde kàtɛn u ndaa a ngwal naa: « La lan'bwà, la lan'bwà, Babilɔn làkölàköl! Mpalabà, la lan'bulà ndwà a insɔŋà, ikal ntɔn an'dweelà an'be mà ifà ifà, ikal a nɛn ifà ifà anà ntsür a mbe anà yà ŋingyäy.
Ntɔn nde kànüü in'sɛŋ myanswà vin a un'fur a ipasàsɛ ande. Amfum a mɛɛn bàkyer ipasàsɛ anà nde, atɛɛl a an'yà a mɛɛn bàbulà aŋangim u mbwo a ngwal a un'naaŋ ande wàŋàsöön. »
Mɛ kàwem ndaa asin yan'fà du, yàmutɛɛnà naa: « Làtoo uboboo a bul alà, bɛ in'sɛŋ amɛ, manà bɛ làyàbilà unsà man'be ande anà mukɔɔn abilà unsà mpay ayà iyun'bweel.
Ntɔn man'be ande màkyàsà ibiŋ tii u du, anà Nzam kàyɔbà in'kɔlàŋàyɔŋ ande.
Un'fuur asànaa kàkyer nde bumwɛy, un'fuur mbalà yweel ube abà kàkyer nde. Uboo a kɔɔb kàbünà nde vin ande, bünà sye mbalà yweel ntɔn nde.

Asànaa kàkäl nde unsà làkoo anà unsà un'naaŋ, lun'fuur sye unsà mpay anà unsà un'saabà. Ntɔn nde afàtɛn u mpem ande naa: "Mɛ in'wàmuyaal asànaa mfum un'kaar, mɛ kà in'wà un'kweel un'dim anki, un'saabà usan'bweel anki akà ikikye."
Kyakin, mpay yanswà ayà bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈n ikyer asun'bweel ilä imwɛy kya: ukwà, ukweel anà ngyal, waa bàsun'tɔɔm u mbaa. Ntɔn Mwol Nzam awà kun'tsüül nsaŋ wà ŋangwal. »
Apan, amfum a mɛɛn abà bàkyer ipasàsɛ anà nde anà bàläb un'naaŋ ande, bàkyer asàlel anà bàsàsà in'tär, umpal bàsàman ba un'diŋ a bul aŋàkuŋà.
Ba bàsàkal ukwɛl, ntɔn bɔɔmà a ntaaŋàmbar ande, anà ba bàsàtɛn naa: « Ngyɛb! Ngyɛb! Ɔɔ Babilɔn, bul akölàköl, bul a ngwal! Mbar angye yan'yà u taaŋ làmwɛy mpɛl! »
Atɛɛl an'yà a mɛɛn bàmulel sye anà bàmusà un'saabà ntɔn nde, ntɔn akà mbuur mwɛy ufàsàsom anki iyääl aba:

un'kàbɔ a wɔl, arza, in'kul a ntal anà mpɛr, ipfɛy a in'kà a ntsür, anà byà fruu, byà swa anà byàtsöö, in'te a usɔŋ aŋàbwaŋ, indiir ifà ifà byà mbwaŋ a ngyɔ, byà in'te a ntal, byà brɔnze, byà ishabà itàkal byà marbre,
kanɛl anà köb, may a usɔŋ, mire anà tswà, vin anà may, mfuub anà blɛ, ngɔɔmà anà in'kɔk, mpoonà anà an'shar, asɔ anà baar a bɔlokà.
Bàfàtɛn naa: « Indiir byanswà afakweenà ngye byàkyàyaalà apà ngye, un'naaŋ angye wanswà anà un'kyɔm angye byàkyàdiimà ntɔn ngye anà bya bàfàsàman anki akà ikikye! »
Ayääl abà bàbulà aŋangim u mbwo a un'kaar awà, bàsàkal ukwɛl ntɔn mutiin mpay ayà usàman nde. Ba bàkyer asàlel anà bàsàsà un'saabà.
Ba bàsàtɛn naa: « Ngyɛb! Ngyɛb! Bul akölàköl, làŋàbwaar ipfɛy a in'kà a ntsür, kyàtsöö anà kyàfruu, kyà an'twan a wɔl, in'kul a ntal anà mpɛr.
U taaŋ làmwɛy mpɛl in'naaŋ mbɔɔn myàkyer ayaalà! » Akaptɛn a an'swà banswà anà baar bàkäl muyikyà anà ba, baar a ngyäl anà baar banswà bàfàman ubwaŋ aba u ngyäl, bàkäl ukwɛl,
ba bàsyee in'kwɛŋ umpal bàmɛn ba un'diŋ a bul aŋàkuŋà: « Bul nà làkwe musi a bul a kölàköl alà! »

Ba bàkübà un'twà, bàsyee in'kwɛŋ, bàkyer alelà, bàsyee un'saabà, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Ngyɛb! Ngyɛb! Bul akölàköl alà làpɛ un'naaŋ akà baar banswà bàkäl anà an'swà kà an'dà. U taaŋ làmwɛy mpɛl akà undiir mwɛy kàfàkal anki! »
Du, saŋ ntɔn mbwabà ala! Anà bɛ sye, aŋin'kyɛɛl, antööm anà aŋangɔɔm làsäŋ! Nzam kun'tsüül mbar ntɔn ube kàlakyer nde!

Apan, un'kyeey a ngwal mwɛy kàwɛl nkɔŋ mwɛy asànaa nkà mwɛy yàkölàköl, waa kàtɔɔm ya u ngyäl, anà kàtɛn naa: « Un'fur a nkyɛl nsil wawà awà bàsàtɔɔm Babilɔn, bul akölàköl anà la bàfàsàman anki akà ikikye.

Diim a abɛɛrà a isyäŋ anà adim a ikwɛŋ, abɛɛrà a un'swom anà mfuŋ bàfàsawem anki akà ikikye u ndwà angye. Akà un'kyeer a isal a an'kɔɔ mwɛy bàfàsàman anki u ndwà angye. Akà un'kiin a nkà mwɛy bàfàsàwem anki u ndwà angye.

Mwinà ufàsàpà anki kyɛɛy u ndwà angye. Làso a baar ban'tà bɔr làbenàben bàfàsàwem anki u ndwà angye, ntɔn ayääl angye bàkäl baar ban'söön mfun u mɛɛn, anà u mbwo a in'nwɛŋ angye, ngye kàkyàbwiy in'sɛŋ myanswà ndwaŋ. »
An'kil a aŋangɔɔm, mà aŋin'kyɛɛl, anà mà baar banswà bàdwä u mɛɛn mà bàmɛnà u Babilɔn.
